key_findings: Momelotinib uniquely inhibits JAK1, JAK2 and ACVR1, aiming to treat anemia alongside symptoms and splenomegaly in myelofibrosis.
MOMENTUM is a Phase III trial of momelotinib versus danazol in symptomatic, anemic, JAKi-pretreated patients.
